text:
Priya: Quick loop — post-launch small wave planning. We have a pile of customer asks + bugs. Proposal: prioritize 3 customer-facing bugs (blocking signups, streaming token leak, search embeddings flakiness) + 1 delight enhancement (compact suggestions UI). Can we decide owners and ship plan by end of this sprint?

Mateo: +1 on focusing. The streaming token leak is causing p99 increases for 2 long-running sessions. I can take it if we agree to pause nonurgent refactors. Link to error logs: https://internal/logs/streaming/1832

Anya: Mateo — I can help with tests and add an e2e for long-run streaming. Also we should avoid broad rollout; do a canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. I added a mini checklist: `repro steps, unit tests, regression test, canary plan`.

Zoe: Customer-success flagged embeddings flakiness for two enterprise customers (search failures ~3% queries). They want a fix asap but said rollback risk acceptable if we communicate. CC @customer-success for details.

customer-success: Yep — we have one FRT (feature request ticket) and one P0 for signups. Signups issue is the top churn risk, happening on Dedicated customers during onboarding. Need owner and ETA.

Jordan: I can own the signup flow bug. Root cause looks like session token expiry race when switching from hosted -> dedicated routing. I can do a patch + unit tests. Estimate: 1 dev-day + 0.5 QA day, target Wed EOD.

Carlos: We should rank by customer impact + regressions in metrics. My suggestion: 1) Signups (Jordan), 2) Streaming token leak (Mateo + Anya), 3) Embeddings flake (Zoe), 4) Delight UI (small perf/UX) as stretch. If we only get two done, pick 1+2.

Priya: Sounds sane. Can we also decide cutoffs and release policy? I'd like to keep the delight enhancement as an opt-in feature flag so it doesn't block hotfixes.

Anya: Agreed. Feature flag for UI. For the streaming change, we need a migration plan for running KV caches — will update runbook.

Mateo: Timeline check: if Jordan is Wed EOD, I need Thu-Fri to validate long-run stability + canary. Embeddings fix could be next sprint if we put it as high severity but lower ROI.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Canary environment created for branch `fix/signup-token-race` — canary % = 5%. Creator: @Jordan.

Jordan: Thanks, deploy-bot. I'll watch metrics and add an alert for errors > 0.5% in canary.

Zoe: For embeddings — customer-success: can you loop in the customers and get two failing query examples? That'll speed up root cause.

customer-success: On it. Sending examples to #support-embeddings and tagging Zoe.

Priya: Ok final decision: lock plan — 3 prioritized bugs + 1 delight flagged opt-in. Owners: Jordan(signup), Mateo+Anya(streaming), Zoe(embeddings). Milestone: `small-wave-quickloop-1832`. Ship target: incremental releases — signup patch Wed EOD, streaming stabilization full rollout Fri if canary looks good, embeddings triaged next sprint, delight as opt-in.

Carlos: I'll update roadmap doc and move the backlog tickets into the milestone. Also will add capacity notes for Dedicated pools — may need a short reslice.

Anya: I'll schedule a 30m grooming session today 4pm to go through acceptance criteria and tests. Invite sent.

Priya: Thanks all. If anyone hits an unblocker, ping me. Otherwise I'll create the milestone and assign tasks after the grooming. :thumbsup:

Mateo: Quick note — if streaming fix requires kernel tuning, loop in eng-runtime early. We don't want last-minute perf rollbacks.

Jordan: Understood. I'll flag runtime if perf deviates >10% during canary.

Priya: Perfect. Closing thread — moving to action items.

deploy-bot: [note] Milestone `small-wave-quickloop-1832` created by Priya.

Priya: Great. Thanks everyone! :tada:
